description: React component for the mobile version of the channel header in Mattermost, handling UI rendering and sidebar toggle logic.

classes.name: MobileChannelHeader
classes.description: React component class for rendering the mobile channel header with sidebar controls and menu options.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds click event listener to hide sidebars when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes click event listener when component unmounts.

methods.name: hideSidebars
methods.description: Handles click events to close sidebars if open and click target is outside toggle buttons.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the header UI, including menu buttons, channel info, and conditional headings.
